grammar.title: Doing two things at once with 一边...一边...
grammar.pattern: 一边 + 动词1，一边 + 动词2
grammar.explanation: 一边...一边... (yìbiān...yìbiān...) shows two actions happening at the same time, done by the same person — "while doing A, also doing B". Both verbs go right after 一边.

grammar.title: Both... and... with 又...又...
grammar.pattern: 又 + 形容词1，又 + 形容词2
grammar.explanation: 又...又... (yòu...yòu...) links two qualities or actions that are both true at the same time — "both A and B". It's often used with two adjectives describing the same subject.

sentences.zh: 只有努力学习，你才能成功。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu nǔlì xuéxí, nǐ cái néng chénggōng.
sentences.en: Only by studying hard can you succeed.

sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiāoxi shǐ tā hěn gāoxìng.
sentences.en: This news made him very happy.

sentences.pinyin: Tā de nǔlì shǐ tā chénggōng le.

sentences.en: Are you going? Of course I am!
This question is of course very important.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ dāngrán jìde nǐ de míngzi.
sentences.en: Of course I remember your name.

sentences.pinyin: Nǐ yuè nǔlì, jiù yuè chénggōng.
sentences.en: The harder you try, the more successful you'll be.
